messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1482 ready for final pass. Small naming/lint nits left. Need one more reviewer and an approval to merge before tomorrow's deploy window (2026-03-18 10:00 PDT).
lee: On it, taking a look now.
anika: @morgan quick Q — are we aiming to change the DB column name or just struct/json tags?
morgan: Prefer to keep DB as `request_id` and change struct/JSON tags. Pushed a tiny commit to adjust tags.
morgan: ```diff
- type Probe struct { reqId string `"json:\"req_id\"` }
+ type Probe struct { RequestID string `"json:\"request_id\"` }
```
sam: lgtm for the tag change. One formatting nit: run `gofmt -w ./internal/kv_cache.go` — there's a long chained call that wraps weirdly.
oscar: kicked CI for the branch.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #1482 — checks: build, unit-tests, linters.
lee: small naming note — internal package vars can stay camelCase. Struct exported fields should be PascalCase. I can approve once CI passes.
anika: approved. :white_check_mark:
lee: approved. :thumbsup:
morgan: thanks all, I'll hold merge until CI is green and then merge right after. tagging release team: @release-schedule
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #1482 — all checks green.
